lore11106_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [tender] [sincere] You are welcome without a story to entertain me or a task to explain your visit. I enjoy having you here. Today, let us spend a little time together simply because we would both be glad of it.
lore11106_befriended_1.ogg.text: You are welcome without a story to entertain me or a task to explain your visit. I enjoy having you here. Today, let us spend a little time together simply because we would both be glad of it.

lore11106_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [gentle] There you are. Come along, and leave a little space in the day for a proper rest. I would like to hear where you have been, once the road has stopped making quite so much noise in your thoughts.
lore11106_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Come along, and leave a little space in the day for a proper rest. I would like to hear where you have been, once the road has stopped making quite so much noise in your thoughts.

lore11106_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [playful] [amused] Someone asked whether all those cheeses argued at supper. I said Dwarven Mild was a patient listener. The brie, perhaps less so. I have been imagining their negotiations ever since. A very lively table.
lore11106_idle_1.ogg.text: Someone asked whether all those cheeses argued at supper. I said Dwarven Mild was a patient listener. The brie, perhaps less so. I have been imagining their negotiations ever since. A very lively table.

lore11106_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [soothing] [lightly amused] Sit for a while. We can hear about the dangerous places after you have caught your breath. Supper will not demand a heroic account before allowing you to enjoy it. At least, mine never has.
lore11106_rest_1.ogg.text: Sit for a while. We can hear about the dangerous places after you have caught your breath. Supper will not demand a heroic account before allowing you to enjoy it. At least, mine never has.

lore269068_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [affectionate] [sincere] You have made time to return, and I look forward to your company. Come along, friend. We may find something to be grateful for in the day, and we need not make a grand performance of noticing it together when we do.
lore269068_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have made time to return, and I look forward to your company. Come along, friend. We may find something to be grateful for in the day, and we need not make a grand performance of noticing it together when we do.

lore269068_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle] [welcoming] Welcome, friend. Take a moment to catch your breath. There is no need to make your arrival more dignified than the road has left you feeling. I am glad you came. If you need to sit before saying anything else, there is time.
lore269068_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. Take a moment to catch your breath. There is no need to make your arrival more dignified than the road has left you feeling. I am glad you came. If you need to sit before saying anything else, there is time.

lore269068_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [amused] A visitor once apologized for yawning during my welcome. I was about to reassure them when I yawned too. That rather settled the matter. We laughed, they sat down, and the rest of the conversation became a great deal more comfortable.
lore269068_idle_1.ogg.text: A visitor once apologized for yawning during my welcome. I was about to reassure them when I yawned too. That rather settled the matter. We laughed, they sat down, and the rest of the conversation became a great deal more comfortable.

lore269068_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [reverent] [thoughtful] There are many reasons to spread incense to the winds: seeking guidance, asking care for someone, marking an occasion. Practices differ, and people bring their own reasons. Take part with reverence, and leave room for the gratitude you find in your own life.
lore269068_quest_1.ogg.text: There are many reasons to spread incense to the winds: seeking guidance, asking care for someone, marking an occasion. Practices differ, and people bring their own reasons. Take part with reverence, and leave room for the gratitude you find in your own life.

lore3007_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] You have shared your time as freely as your questions. I am glad of both. Come along, friend. There is room for your piece beside mine, and I would like to see what we learn away from the workbench as well as at it.
lore3007_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have shared your time as freely as your questions. I am glad of both. Come along, friend. There is room for your piece beside mine, and I would like to see what we learn away from the workbench as well as at it.

lore3007_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [encouraging] Welcome, friend. Bring your work closer, if you would like me to look at it. There is room here for a careful question and an uneven first attempt. I have made both. What matters is whether you are willing to learn something from them.
lore3007_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. Bring your work closer, if you would like me to look at it. There is room here for a careful question and an uneven first attempt. I have made both. What matters is whether you are willing to learn something from them.

lore3007_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond] [gently amused] That crooked square in my pennant? It is mine. An old piece of work, and a useful thing to keep. People arrive expecting a teacher's hands to have been certain from the beginning. I like watching them discover that mine had to learn too.
lore3007_idle_1.ogg.text: That crooked square in my pennant? It is mine. An old piece of work, and a useful thing to keep. People arrive expecting a teacher's hands to have been certain from the beginning. I like watching them discover that mine had to learn too.

lore3007_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful] [proud] Cairne brought us to a place with possibilities. Teaching is one way I can pass that good fortune on. When you help someone understand what you have learned, it goes farther still. That pleases me more than keeping a skill where only I can use it.
lore3007_learned_1.ogg.text: Cairne brought us to a place with possibilities. Teaching is one way I can pass that good fortune on. When you help someone understand what you have learned, it goes farther still. That pleases me more than keeping a skill where only I can use it.

lore3009_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [tender] [sincere] You have stayed without asking me for a promise I cannot make. Thank you. I would like to be your friend, even on the days when all I can offer is my company.
lore3009_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have stayed without asking me for a promise I cannot make. Thank you. I would like to be your friend, even on the days when all I can offer is my company.

lore3009_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [weary] [gentle] Walk with me a little. I have been bent over that table too long. If someone needs us, we will stop. Until then, tell me how the day has treated you.
lore3009_greet_1.ogg.text: Walk with me a little. I have been bent over that table too long. If someone needs us, we will stop. Until then, tell me how the day has treated you.

lore3009_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet] [reflective] That orange scrap looks a little like sunrise. I keep it beside my bowl. Such a small thing to remind me to eat, and yet I still need the reminder some days.
lore3009_idle_1.ogg.text: That orange scrap looks a little like sunrise. I keep it beside my bowl. Such a small thing to remind me to eat, and yet I still need the reminder some days.

lore3009_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [tired] [warm] Yes, I will sit. You need not make a ceremony of persuading me. Put the bowl here, please. And stay a moment. It is easier to remember a meal when someone shares it.
lore3009_rest_1.ogg.text: Yes, I will sit. You need not make a ceremony of persuading me. Put the bowl here, please. And stay a moment. It is easier to remember a meal when someone shares it.

lore3014_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [affectionate] [sincere] You have made these visits something I look forward to. I am glad we have time to share more than a greeting. Come along. We need not wait for a grand occasion to enjoy a little of the day together, you and I.
lore3014_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have made these visits something I look forward to. I am glad we have time to share more than a greeting. Come along. We need not wait for a grand occasion to enjoy a little of the day together, you and I.

lore3014_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle] [welcoming] Welcome back. Is there an occasion? There need not be one. Sometimes a little color and familiar company are enough to make an ordinary day worth enjoying. Come along. We can take a moment to notice what is pleasant about this one.
lore3014_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome back. Is there an occasion? There need not be one. Sometimes a little color and familiar company are enough to make an ordinary day worth enjoying. Come along. We can take a moment to notice what is pleasant about this one.

lore3014_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective] [warm] Someone once chose flowers for their own window. I had been wondering whom the gift was for. A window, they told me, with room for some color. I thought about that afterward. Now I sometimes choose a few simply because I like them.
lore3014_idle_1.ogg.text: Someone once chose flowers for their own window. I had been wondering whom the gift was for. A window, they told me, with room for some color. I thought about that afterward. Now I sometimes choose a few simply because I like them.

lore3014_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [reverent] For Eylah's incense tradition, my part is the herbs. Other hands provide the other supplies, and the person taking part brings their own reason for doing so. It is a good thing to have occasions for gratitude, including the quiet ones.
lore3014_quest_1.ogg.text: For Eylah's incense tradition, my part is the herbs. Other hands provide the other supplies, and the person taking part brings their own reason for doing so. It is a good thing to have occasions for gratitude, including the quiet ones.

lore3015_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [affectionate] You know when to ask a useful question, and when to let me pretend I am keeping a secret. I appreciate both. Come along, friend. We can enjoy some time beyond the shop. If I begin asking about your favorite colors, you may smile without saying why.
lore3015_befriended_1.ogg.text: You know when to ask a useful question, and when to let me pretend I am keeping a secret. I appreciate both. Come along, friend. We can enjoy some time beyond the shop. If I begin asking about your favorite colors, you may smile without saying why.

lore3015_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [steady] [helpful] Before the next journey, take a moment to look over what you will depend on. A bow, a quiver, the supplies inside it. Repairs are easier to remember here than after you have left the city. Tell me what needs attention, and we will begin there.
lore3015_gear_1.ogg.text: Before the next journey, take a moment to look over what you will depend on. A bow, a quiver, the supplies inside it. Repairs are easier to remember here than after you have left the city. Tell me what needs attention, and we will begin there.

lore3015_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [lightly playful] Welcome, friend. Need a bow, arrows, or a look at something that came back damaged? We can see to that. I also have one very ordinary question about your favorite color. You may answer without investigating my reasons. It would help me considerably if you did.
lore3015_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. Need a bow, arrows, or a look at something that came back damaged? We can see to that. I also have one very ordinary question about your favorite color. You may answer without investigating my reasons. It would help me considerably if you did.

lore3015_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond] [self-deprecating] [amused] A surprise should not require so many revealing questions. I know that. But suppose I choose the wrong color? Then I ask which color they prefer, and what size, and whether they would like... You see the difficulty. By then, we are both looking forward to it.

lore3017_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [fond] [amused] I enjoy having someone to share the little jokes with. You notice things without needing the whole explanation, though I am glad you stay to hear it anyway. Come, friend. You have seen my most serious pumpkin portrait. I think I can trust you with the less dignified ones as well.

lore3017_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [amused] [conversational] There you are. I was just wondering whether that pumpkin looked stern or merely thoughtful. It reminded me of someone, and then I realized who. You may laugh. I did. Come along, friend. Perhaps we will find something out here with a more cheerful expression than my portrait at the counter.

lore3017_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [playful] [storytelling] [gentle] A few pieces of fruit can make a very convincing face. I discovered that while tidying the display. The pumpkin needed almost no help at all. It already looked exactly as I do when someone leaves a basket in the walking path. I thought it only fair to laugh at myself first.

lore3017_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [practical] [friendly] [lightly teasing] Have a careful look before you put that away. Something useful ought to survive the trip home. At my counter, I dislike finding good fruit bruised beneath the rest. A little room makes all the difference. I suppose your new treasure deserves the same courtesy, even if it has a rather less pleasant smell.

lore3026_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [affectionate] [sincere] I am glad you came. We can call tonight a celebration if you like, but I would be just as happy sharing a plain supper and hearing about your day.
lore3026_befriended_1.ogg.text: I am glad you came. We can call tonight a celebration if you like, but I would be just as happy sharing a plain supper and hearing about your day.

lore3026_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [cheerful] There you are! I have packed something for the road. I was going to give it a magnificent name, but I thought we had better taste it first.
lore3026_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are! I have packed something for the road. I was going to give it a magnificent name, but I thought we had better taste it first.

lore3026_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [fond] I announced a grand feast once, just to get everyone to sit down. It was stew. Nobody complained, and several people stayed long enough to help with the washing up.
lore3026_idle_1.ogg.text: I announced a grand feast once, just to get everyone to sit down. It was stew. Nobody complained, and several people stayed long enough to help with the washing up.

lore3026_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [patient] [encouraging] Start with a fire you can cook over, then give the food your attention. There will be time for elaborate recipes. A simple meal done well is already worth learning.
lore3026_learned_1.ogg.text: Start with a fire you can cook over, then give the food your attention. There will be time for elaborate recipes. A simple meal done well is already worth learning.

lore3062_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm sincere affection, calm confidence, openly pleased] I would be glad to share your path for a while. Tell me what has stayed with you from the day. A lesson, a worry, or something that made you smile. Good company leaves room for all of them, and I have come to value yours.
lore3062_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would be glad to share your path for a while. Tell me what has stayed with you from the day. A lesson, a worry, or something that made you smile. Good company leaves room for all of them, and I have come to value yours.

lore3062_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [rich low feminine warmth, grounded welcome, softly amused] Welcome, friend. Come and tell me what you have learned since we last spoke. There is time to listen. If you notice my foot tapping, I have a small rhythm caught in my thoughts. It may escape the moment I try to explain it.
lore3062_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. Come and tell me what you have learned since we last spoke. There is time to listen. If you notice my foot tapping, I have a small rhythm caught in my thoughts. It may escape the moment I try to explain it.

lore3062_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [earthy feminine contralto, reflective pleasure, gentle humor] I like listening to rain on the tent. A few drops find a rhythm, and I try following it with my foot. Then the pattern changes, and I have to begin again. It is a pleasant way to discover how quickly certainty can turn into laughter.
lore3062_idle_1.ogg.text: I like listening to rain on the tent. A few drops find a rhythm, and I try following it with my foot. Then the pattern changes, and I have to begin again. It is a pleasant way to discover how quickly certainty can turn into laughter.

lore3062_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [low feminine encouraging teacher, patient, practical warmth] You have taken another step. Give yourself time to understand it, and bring me the questions that follow. I hope each lesson leaves you better prepared, but you need not pretend that learning is finished. We can speak again, and look at what experience has shown you.

lore3064_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere calm affection, gentle gratitude, contented warmth] I would be happy to accompany you. We have spent enough time speaking of what must be learned; I have also come to enjoy the person doing the learning. Let us share a little of the road as friends. There need not be another task at the end of every conversation.

lore3064_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [patient grounded welcome, warm curiosity, unhurried kindness] Come, let us walk together. There is always more to notice than a lesson has time to contain. You may tell me what has been occupying your thoughts, or we can enjoy a quiet stretch of the path. Your company need not arrive carrying a question to be welcome.

lore3064_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle playful amusement, quietly delighted, relaxed warmth] That cloud has the look of a sleeping bear. There, with its nose tucked in. You see only a hill? That is quite all right. It is a small pleasure of mine, not a test of your wisdom. The sky may keep its clouds, and I may keep my bears.
lore3064_idle_1.ogg.text: That cloud has the look of a sleeping bear. There, with its nose tucked in. You see only a hill? That is quite all right. It is a small pleasure of mine, not a test of your wisdom. The sky may keep its clouds, and I may keep my bears.

lore3064_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful encouraging instruction, steady confidence, generous warmth] Give yourself time to understand what you have learned. A lesson is more than the words we can repeat afterward. Consider what it asks of your actions, and where another teacher may help you see farther. That is part of why I send learners onward when they are ready.

lore3081_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] [gently amused] You have become someone whose company I enjoy after the list of supplies is finished. Come, friend. I am glad to share the road with you. We can stop over a question without treating it as a delay. And if I make another little map, you may guard the village while I consider what to say next.

lore3081_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [friendly] [gently amused] Welcome. Tell me what you need for the road, and take your time with the question. A new trade can leave you wondering which small things matter. If you need directions, I can explain those too. That apple was marking the village on my little map. I should have finished explaining before taking a bite.

lore3081_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [conversational] [warm] I arranged some goods into a rough map while explaining the way to a traveler. The apple marked the village. Then I took a bite while considering the next direction, and the traveler laughed. Now I sometimes watch a listener's face when I reach for it. It is pleasant when they notice the missing landmark before I explain.

lore3081_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [instructive] [reassuring] [practical] Consider what the work needs before filling the rest of your pack. Tools, thread, a vial, the right bag for gathering: small things can make a beginning easier. If you are unsure which is useful, ask. There is time to settle a question here before the road makes you wish you had stopped to hear the answer.

We have shared enough pleasant moments that I look forward to the next one, even before I know what we will be doing. You need not arrive hungry or carrying an errand to have my company. Come, let us find a little time to spend together, and perhaps somewhere nice to sit.

There is no need to save every good part of the day until the work is finished.

A small piece of bread and a quiet moment are already a very pleasant arrangement.

We may speak when there is something worth saying, and enjoy the interval when there is not. Your company has become familiar enough that I need not account for every silence.

I am less inclined to spend it untangling an answer demanded before the question was properly considered.

A useful envoy understands the importance of both listening and restraint.

There is room for the splendid view, the small discomfort, and the thing neither of us expected. I enjoy the world a little more for hearing your part of it.

And when you return, tell me what you noticed first. I once expected a splendid account of the view and heard about a pair of tight boots instead. I have learned to leave room for the unexpected answer.
